== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Published weapon attachment changes ‘any T-47’ to ‘your T-47.’ A Light vehicle can have an opposing controller under the period rules, and the ordinary rule for a vehicle firing a weapon remains separately tied to its controller. The two hit formulas, no-cost target, character forfeit zero and pilot-ability cap remain.
